title: Fourier coefficients of the odd BLR counterexample
statement: Let $T$ be any subset of $\{0,1\}$. For the fixed Boolean function on the two-dimensional sign cube used as a counterexample to the odd BLR book bound, its Fourier coefficient at $T$ equals one half of the indicator that $T$ is empty, minus one half for each of the three nonempty subsets $\{0\}$, $\{1\}$, and $\{0,1\}$ that equals $T$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the defining construction of the fixed Boolean function, so its identity cannot be specified more fully from the payload.
